sources.title: BatterySwapAI - NORA - Norwegian Artificial Intelligence Research ...
sources.snippet: You are the operator of a fleet of battery-powered IoT sensor devices, deployed across many buildings over a wide area. As the sensors are starting to run out of battery - you are faced with the challenge: How to know which batteries need replacing when, and what is a good strategy for doing the replacements? This is the challenge we pose to you in this competition.

sources.title: Participant Guide — Set Up and Version a Submission Repository - nora.ai
sources.snippet: The same repository can be used for multiple submissions. Git provides the versioning: when a result is submitted, the competition backoffice records the Git commit SHA associated with that submission. Later commits therefore create new versions without replacing earlier submitted results.
